full.citation: “A Full Action requires the character's full turn to accomplish.”

half.description: Consumes roughly half of the character's turn.
half.citation: “Half Actions are simple and only require some effort.”

reaction.description: Used to respond to incoming actions; does not consume the character's turn.
reaction.penalty_rule: Each Reaction after the first gains a stacking -10 penalty.
reaction.citation: “Each time a Reaction is made, any Reaction afterwards is at a stacking -10 Penalty.”

free.description: Takes negligible time; may be performed alongside other actions.
free.citation: “A Free Action takes only a snap of the finger to use.”
